Overview

Pohang is a city in GBN with a population of 511,000. A coastal industrial city in eastern Korea, home to POSCO’s massive steelworks and beautiful beaches. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
